citations.label: Single-Agent LLMs Outperform Multi-Agent Systems ... Under Equal Thinking Token Budgets (arXiv 2604.02460)
citations.excerpt: Overall, our results suggest that, for multi-hop reasoning tasks, many reported advantages of multi-agent systems are better explained by unaccounted computation and context effects rather than inherent architectural benefits.

citations.label: Augment Code, Why Multi-Agent LLM Systems Fail
citations.excerpt: The MAST failure taxonomy, validated across 1,600+ execution traces at NeurIPS 2025, maps 14 failure modes to three root categories: specification ambiguity, coordination breakdowns, and verification gaps.
